style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: poetic sweeping cosmic panorama, luminous warm gold nebula blending into deep indigo and violet, one beautiful spiral galaxy central-right and small blue-green Earth lower-left to invite exploration. No characters, no sun face. Not a literal scientific timeline, no panels.

Conceptual earliest dense hot state: tiny concentrated brilliant amber-white glow at image center, softly radiating into a nearly uniform warm-dark violet field. Minimal abstract visualization, not a star in an existing starfield. No planets, mature stars, galaxies, debris, or external landscape. Strong sense of concentrated heat and density; no fireball or bomb.

Conceptual hot early expanding universe, FULL FRAME filled with diffuse luminous hot golden plasma and soft orange-violet gradients, clear center area luminous but no hard boundary or explosion debris. No planets, galaxies, existing starfield or outer void surrounding a blast. Abstract energetic expansion of space rather than explosion in space.

Visual analogy of space stretching: one smooth continuous translucent violet-blue flexible lattice fills frame, mesh cells become gradually wider from left to right; the same small soft colored abstract dots repeat attached at grid intersections, farther apart at right. Warm glow. No literal stars shooting away from a point, no balloon string, no multiple disconnected universes, no text or arrows.

First light concept: warm soft golden luminous wave ribbons permeate translucent violet cosmic mist across entire frame. Delicate dispersed glints, readable broad glow near middle-lower area. No stars, planets, galaxies, lamps or hard laser beams. Calm abstract luminous space.

Magnified conceptual particles as small soft orange, blue and lavender spheres. On left individual spheres separated; at center-right little clusters of two to four gently joined spheres show building blocks coming together. Dark indigo background warm glow. No LEGO blocks, no molecular labels, no giant atoms with planetary orbits. This is a conceptual not-to-scale illustration.

Star formation scene: a large glowing ROUND warm golden newborn star center-left nestled in a gentle violet cloud of gas, luminous gas filaments gathering around it. A smaller dense luminous knot right in gas cloud. No five-pointed star, no planets or city, no explosion, no face. Round star visibly brighter than its surroundings.

Galaxy page: a large clearly structured spiral galaxy left with curved arms made of countless tiny luminous stars, a smaller oval elliptical galaxy at right. Deep navy negative space separates them, blue-violet and warm gold palette. Both recognizable as enormous star collections, no planets mistaken for galaxies, no faces.

Solar system child-friendly selective view: large round golden Sun at upper-right, much smaller recognizable blue-green Earth lower-left; a few tiny distinct other worlds in distance. Subtle thin pale orbital curves around Sun acceptable but no arrows. Earth lit on Sun-facing side. No rings on Earth, no extra moons, no surrounding galaxy swirl, no labels. Not to scale, focus only Sun and Earth.

Immense modern universe: rich deep indigo cosmic panorama with several clearly separate spiral and oval galaxies of different sizes, brightest spiral at upper-right; luminous individual foreground star lower-middle clearly distinct from galaxy collections. Warm gold and cool blue stellar points, no dense confetti obscuring main subjects. No Earth dominating scene.

Unlabeled educational recap on gentle indigo background: loosely spaced distinct watercolor cosmic studies arranged around large central spiral galaxy: tiny hot glow, soft luminous plasma, stretchable lattice patch, light wave ribbon, particle cluster, round golden star, small Sun and blue-green Earth. No arrows, no panels, no text, no duplicate giant suns, no crowding. Clear individual silhouettes for visual recall.
